published.source: Report re-sim on master abd7cd3, 2026-10-16: no level-based partial resist (#102) and the pass 23 rotations (#98 to #105) (was 683.0)

summary: Backstab on daggers with Seal Fate from Assassination.
rotation: Uses the Combat Daggers rotation (no Adrenaline Rush or Blade Flurry talents, so those lines are skipped)
Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Backstab right after a main-hand swing (0.25s), or at 100 energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Improved Sinister Strike 2 adds no DPS.
Murder does nothing on the generic boss, so its points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir left out (+8 through Dragonbreath Chili).
notes: Spec family set to Assassination (30 Assassination points); the PR frames it as a variant of Combat Daggers and it uses the rogue_combat mksettings setup and the Combat Daggers APL. The talent preset tooltip mentions Blade Flurry, but the talent string has no Blade Flurry point.
